15221:           && member.team?.status === 'active'

14997:       `;

15002:           <span class="badge ${team.presidentUsername ? 'good' : 'warn'}">${team.presidentUsername ? 'OK' : 'NO PRES.'}</span>
15003:         </div>
15004:       `).join('') || '<div class="small soft">Nessuna squadra.</div>';
